rules.family: reject topology duplicate, near duplicate or wall near duplicate of p1-02-v1 or an accepted family
rules.lineage: exclude the family if any lineage fails or collides with a historical set
rules.pilot_maps: exclude the family if its map has the topology hash of, or is a near or wall near duplicate (frozen generator thresholds, also without scale and aspect gates over all 8 grid symmetries) of, any map of the pilot sets
